# CAR-T Designer

CAR-T Designer: An optimization platform for chimeric antigen receptor constructs, suggesting scFv domains and signaling elements for specific cancer antigens.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Antigen/scFv/costim selection is curated rules; placeholder binder for unsupported scFv explicitly flagged; not trained optimized patient construct.

text: It predicts potential toxicities and simulates clinical trial outcomes.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Toxicity and trial response class-level equations, not fitted per-antigen/patient clinical outcomes.

text: CAR-T Designer enables the engineering of safe and effective immune cell therapies, accelerating the development of personalized immunotherapies for cancer.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.

# Living Tx

Living Tx: A design tool for engineered probiotics used as living therapeutics for disease treatment.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Curated payload/chassis ranking plus community ODE exists, not clinically validated living therapeutic design.

text: It suggests safe strains and genetic modifications while simulating their impact on the gut microbiome.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Static safety traits, containment concepts and population equations; safe strains/genetic intervention efficacy not established experimentally.

text: Living Tx predicts clinical success probabilities and models therapeutic compound delivery, providing a platform for developing next-generation biological medicines.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Legacy predicted_clinical_success is fixed weighted trait score; newer ODE explicitly no clinical-success prediction and single inoculum, not daily re-dosing. No validated medicine delivery.
